item.title: WA gas prices hit $4.63, up more than 25 cents in a week
item.description: Washingtonians are paying $4.63 on average for a gallon of gas, about 33% more than the average American as prices surge more than a week into the U.S. and Israel’s war on Iran, according to AAA.

item.title: Seattle City Light proposes $4 billion for Skagit River hydropower dams
item.description: Seattle City Light, the city's electric utility, has agreed to commit about $4 billion to continue to operate its hydropower dams on the Skagit River over the next 50 years.

item.title: ‘Sinners,’ ‘The Pitt’ win big at Writers Guild Awards after LA ceremony cancellation
item.description: The already highly decorated "Sinners" was among the top winners at the 78th Writers Guild Awards on Sunday in New York City.

item.title: Authorities say a Georgia teacher was killed in a prank gone wrong. A teen is charged with homicide
item.description: GAINESVILLE, Ga. — It was a prank that turned deadly, authorities said: A group of teenagers unspooled rolls of toilet paper outside the home of a beloved high school teacher who tripped in the street and was struck by a pickup truck as the pranksters started to drive away.

item.title: Want to sell a WA home? Your broker can’t keep it hush-hush
item.description: The Legislature nearly unanimously passed a bill Wednesday banning real estate brokers from marketing the sale or lease of residential real estate to an exclusive group.

item.title: These lawmakers were shaped by combat after 9/11. Now they’re grappling with a new Mideast war
item.description: WASHINGTON — As Congress responds to President Donald Trump's attack on Iran, lawmakers who served on the front lines of Iraq and Afghanistan are making their voices heard in a war debate that has taken on intensely personal meaning.

item.title: Call to Readers: How are gas prices affecting you?
item.description: Are rising gas prices causing you to change your daily routines or pinching your household budget? If so, reporter Doug Flanagan wants to hear from you by 5 p.m. Wednesday. He can be reached at 360-735-4669 or doug.flanagan@columbian.com.

item.title: Seahawks bringing back wide receiver Rashid Shaheed
item.description: Receiver Rashid Shaheed agreed Monday afternoon to re-sign with the Seattle Seahawks on a three-year deal worth up to $51 million with $34.7 million guaranteed, according to various reports.

item.title: Ethan Harris of Camas selected as 4A state player of the year by basketball coaches association
item.description: Ethan Harris of Camas has been selected as the Class 4A state player of the year by the Washington Interscholastic Basketball Coaches Association.

item.title: No. 12 Gonzaga beats Oregon State 65-56, advances to 29th straight WCC final
item.description: Graham Ike had 24 points and 11 rebounds to lead No. 12 Gonzaga to a 65-56 victory over Oregon State on Monday night and put the Bulldogs in the West Coast Conference Tournament championship game for the 29th straight time.
